description:
Study the formula. Open the storm, then merge every pictured pair into the Stormglass heart. Reagents keep drifting while you hold another. Dotted paths show the next 2.5 seconds; solid wakes show the last 0.8 seconds. New blends must form for 5 seconds before reuse; their blue inner ring shows readiness. Hot blends crystallize when their rings empty. A missed release, wrong mixture, or crystallized blend ends the batch. Certify only the complete heart.

Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to pre-existing, unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Task-opened tabs are allowed only when part of this task and only through their visible controls.
name: CRAFTCHA: Alchemy Bench V2 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
